title: Breaking Bad
description: A high school chemistry teacher diagnosed with cancer turns to making methamphetamine to secure his family's future.
facts: Creator Vince Gilligan pitched it as a story about turning 'Mr. Chips into Scarface'.
The show is set and was filmed in Albuquerque, New Mexico.
Bryan Cranston won four Emmy Awards for Outstanding Lead Actor in a Drama Series for playing Walter White.
Jesse Pinkman was originally planned to die in the first season, but the writers kept Aaron Paul's character.
It ran for five seasons and 62 episodes, from 2008 to 2013.
The show's blue crystals were made from rock candy rather than anything illegal.
The finale, 'Felina', aired on September 29, 2013, and drew about 10.3 million US viewers.
The prequel spin-off Better Call Saul premiered in 2015.
Gilligan remembered Cranston from his guest role in an X-Files episode he had written.
The Los Pollos Hermanos restaurant exteriors were filmed at a real Albuquerque restaurant called Twisters.

title: Stranger Things
description: In 1980s Indiana, a boy's disappearance exposes secret experiments, supernatural forces and a girl with psychokinetic powers.
facts: The Duffer Brothers created it, and its working title was 'Montauk'.
The fictional town of Hawthorne, Indiana is mostly filmed in Georgia, including in the town of Jackson.
All of season one premiered on Netflix on July 15, 2016.
Millie Bobby Brown shaved her head for the role of Eleven in the first season.
The title lettering is inspired by the covers of Stephen King paperbacks and uses the ITC Benguiat typeface.
The monster Demogorgon is named after a demon from Dungeons & Dragons.
The creators reportedly were turned down by more than a dozen networks before Netflix picked it up.
Kate Bush's 'Running Up That Hill' climbed back up the charts worldwide after it featured in season four in 2022.
The season four finale-adjacent episode 'Piggyback' runs roughly two and a half hours.
Season one begins in November 1983.
